title: chat-server: sender_id on OutboundEvent::Receipt
description: chinwag-nuqe.7.20. Under burnOnRead the Message is destroyed before the receipt event is handled, so the deployment cannot address Peer/receipt (recipientUserId = the message's original sender, fed c08568e L645). Add sender_id: Id (the original Message's senderId, a ChatContact id) to OutboundEvent::Receipt in crate-jmap-chat-server/src/outbound.rs (~L107-120); set it where the event is built, message.rs ~L2207 (m is the owned pre-patch Message, already filtered m.sender_id != account_id at ~L2199). Fix doc drift: outbound.rs ~L102-105, backend.rs ~L935, message.rs ~L2281 quote 'MUST NOT invoke Peer/receipt'; at c08568e Sender Behavior says SHOULD NOT. Tests: update receipt() helper tests/outbound_events.rs ~L759; new test: group Chat, burnOnRead Message from another member, read it -> Receipt event carries that member's sender_id and Message/get returns notFound. Oracle: fed §Peer/receipt recipientUserId (L645), chat-00 §Message burnOnRead. BREAKING (variant gains a field).
close_reason: Batch 31: 954cd247 (sender_id on OutboundEvent::Receipt, BREAKING, CHANGELOG + public-api) + comment fixup; local CI all green (6628 tests stable+beta).
